# `port_request`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

A number port: in (the customer brings a number, submitted to the carrier by the billing worker) or out (the carrier reports a request, validated against the Number Transfer PIN). TMF has no porting API: internal API only.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  | Request id; the carrier idempotency key of a submission is derived from it and the submission count. |
| `direction` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `state` | `text` | no |  | submitted (to send), pending (the carrier has it), rejected (with a code and reason; port-in can be resubmitted), completed, cancelled. A port-out request is decided in the transaction that records it: rejected or completed. |
| `number_value` | `text` | no |  | The number being ported, E.164 digits; a port-out can name a number that is not in inventory (rejected numberUnknown). |
| `subscriber_number_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `carrier_account_number` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `billing_zip` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `first_name` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `last_name` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `transfer_pin` | `text` | yes |  | Port-in: the losing carrier's transfer PIN, kept only until the carrier has accepted the submission, then cleared; never returned by any API. |
| `carrier_reference` | `text` | yes |  | The carrier's reference of the port; for port-out the carrier's request id (unique). |
| `submissions` | `integer` | no | `1` | Port-in: how many times the request was submitted (1 + resubmits). |
| `rejection_code` | `text` | yes |  | Why the carrier or the BSS refused: port-in carrier codes, or for port-out numberUnknown, pinInvalid, pinExpired, lineNotActive, terminationRefused. |
| `rejection_reason` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `product_order_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Port-out: the termination order that ended the product. |
| `answered_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Port-out: when the carrier acknowledged our answer (approved or rejected); null = to send, retried by the worker. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `completed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `port_request_attempts_check` | check | `CHECK ((attempts >= 0))` |
| `port_request_check` | check | `CHECK (((state = 'rejected'::text) = (rejection_code IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `port_request_check1` | check | `CHECK (((state = 'completed'::text) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `port_request_check2` | check | `CHECK (((direction = 'out'::text) OR (subscriber_number_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `port_request_check3` | check | `CHECK (((direction = 'in'::text) OR (state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'completed'::text]))))` |
| `port_request_check4` | check | `CHECK (((direction = 'out'::text) OR (answered_at IS NULL)))` |
| `port_request_check5` | check | `CHECK (((direction = 'in'::text) OR (carrier_reference IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `port_request_direction_check` | check | `CHECK ((direction = ANY (ARRAY['in'::text, 'out'::text])))` |
| `port_request_number_value_check` | check | `CHECK ((number_value ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'::text))` |
| `port_request_state_check` | check | `CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'pending'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))` |
| `port_request_submissions_check` | check | `CHECK ((submissions >= 1))` |
| `port_request_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
